content_of_post_to_answer: What is one small habit that can make your life better?
answer: A small habit that changes lives is keeping a daily note of what you learned, noticed, or questioned. Its value is not the record itself; it trains you to pay attention. Most people move through days collecting experiences but never extracting lessons from them. Reflection turns ordinary moments into feedback, and over time the habit creates a clearer understanding of yourself. The best improvements often come not from doing more, but from noticing more.
